impact: mergeMcpConfig writes { command: 'zug-mcp', args: [] } without type: 'stdio'. Some Claude Code versions and future agent clients may require the explicit type field. Low risk now, forward-compat risk.
resolution: mergeMcpConfig() default entry updated to { type: 'stdio', command: 'zug-mcp', args: [] }. The explicit type field is now always written to MCP config files for all agents.
title: setup.ts MCP entry missing type: stdio field
